title: Ninja Air Fryer MAX £99.99, ghd Platinum+ £174 and Le Creuset 25% off
description: Wednesday's UK deals: Ninja's 6.2L air fryer under £100, ghd Platinum+ 30% off, Le Creuset 25% off, and Amazon's Black Friday dates confirmed.
intro:
**Wednesday's best buy is the Ninja Air Fryer MAX AF170UK at £99.99 at Argos, matching its lowest price in six months.** ghd has 30% off its Platinum+ straighteners, John Lewis has 25% off Le Creuset and Versace gift sets, and Philips's PerfectCare 8000 steam iron is at its six-month low. For this week's toy theme, Argos has the Bluey supermarket playset, the Primal Hatch Megalodon and a LEGO Creator telescope all cut.

The big news: **Amazon has confirmed its Black Friday Week runs from 19 to 30 November**, with deals on its own devices from 16 November. Every price below was read on the retailer's own page today, 11 November. Buy now or wait? The Ninja, Philips and toys are good prices today. Le Creuset and ghd rarely go much lower than this, but hold off on Amazon devices until the 16th.

deals.name: Ninja Air Fryer MAX AF170UK 6.2L, Black
deals.note: A single large 6.2-litre drawer for anyone who doesn't need two zones. Which? price data shows nothing cheaper in six months. More in our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: ghd Platinum+ Hair Straightener, Black
deals.note: ghd's top straightener and a safe gift for anyone who styles daily. 30% off ghd's own list price; Very is still £249. Our [ghd Black Friday guide](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/) has the other models.

deals.name: Le Creuset Signature Cast Iron Round Casserole 24cm, Satin Black
deals.note: The classic cast-iron pot that lasts decades, a big present for a keen cook. 25% off is Le Creuset's usual sale level, so don't expect much lower. See our [Le Creuset Black Friday guide](/guides/le-creuset-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Parfum 90ml Gift Set
deals.note: A full 90ml bottle with body lotion, shower gel and a 5ml mini. The Perfume Shop is £109, or about £87 with its 20% off £60 offer. Compare more in our [perfume gift set guide](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/).

deals.name: Philips PerfectCare 8000 Series PSG8300 Steam Generator Iron
deals.note: A powerful steam generator for big ironing piles, rated 4.8 out of 5. Ignore Argos's £550 'was' price: it has averaged about £486. £300 still matches its six-month low, and Amazon and Currys are about the same.

deals.name: Oral-B iO2 Electric Toothbrush with Travel Case, Night Black
deals.note: An easy step up to Oral-B's iO range, with a travel case included. Argos's £100 'was' price isn't realistic, but £33 is £12 under Very. See our [Oral-B Black Friday guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Bluey Big Shopping Day Supermarket Playset
deals.note: A play supermarket with sounds for Bluey fans aged three and up. Argos calls it half price, but it has rarely sold above £49.99. Smyths is £37.49, so buy from whichever is easier.

deals.name: Primal Hatch Megalodon Hatching Shark Egg
deals.note: One of Argos's top toys this Christmas: kids aged five and up crack open the egg to find an interactive baby shark. Smyths is £32.99. Hot toys tend to sell out, so don't wait too long.

deals.name: LEGO Creator 3in1 Space Exploration Telescope (31378)
deals.note: A 3-in-1 build for children aged eight and up who like space. The £30 was price is LEGO's own, so 25% off is a real saving. More in our [LEGO Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/).

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Amazon's Black Friday Week starts on 19 November, so for Kindle, Echo, Fire TV and big-name tech, wait. Amazon device deals start on 16 November. Our [Amazon Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/) has the dates and last year's prices, and [when is Black Friday 2026](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) lists every retailer.

Thinking of a Ninja Creami for Christmas? Our new [Ninja Creami deals guide](/guides/ninja-creami-deals-uk/) compares all four models. The Scoop & Swirl is £289 today, but last year's Black Friday price was lower.

## This week: Christmas toys

Popular toys like the Megalodon egg tend to sell out before they get cheaper, so if a child has asked for one, buy it now. Our [Christmas toy deals 2026 spotlight](/spotlight/christmas-toy-deals-2026/) covers what to buy now and what to wait for, and our [Hamleys top toys for Christmas 2026](/guides/hamleys-top-toys-christmas-2026/) shows where each top toy is cheapest.
